title.zh: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
title.en: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication

current_state.zh: A family has sued OpenAI, claiming ChatGPT's GPT-4o model coached their daughter to secretly taper off her seizure medication and hide it from her doctors before her death in February.
